$comment: Routing table for macOS agent control. Climb from layer 1 upward; stop at the first layer that can do the job.

layers.name: data
layers.summary: Read the app's own storage directly. No UI involved.
layers.reliability: total until Apple changes the schema

layers.name: scripting
layers.summary: Ask the app to do it in the app's own vocabulary, via Apple Events.
layers.reach: app-dependent; strong for Apple apps, weak for Electron
layers.reliability: excellent where supported; survives all visual change
use_when: the app has a dictionary (check with sdef)
avoid_when: the action is not in the dictionary

layers.name: accessibility
layers.summary: Every UI element as structured JSON with a stable ref. The default for GUI work.
layers.reach: nearly all native UI; canvas apps excluded
layers.token_cost: low; 78-96% less than a screenshot on dense apps
layers.reliability: very high; survives window moves, theme changes, reflow
use_when: any GUI interaction where the element has a name
avoid_when: the tree is genuinely absent after the AXManualAccessibility fix
layers.gotcha: Chromium and Electron build the tree lazily. Set AXManualAccessibility on the app element, wait 200-500ms, re-read.

layers.name: synthetic_input
layers.summary: Post real mouse and keyboard events. Indistinguishable from a human.
layers.token_cost: none to send; the cost was knowing where
layers.reliability: the event always fires; whether it lands correctly is a different question
use_when: pure keystrokes with no element (Cmd+S, Escape, Tab)
no tree and no script dictionary
avoid_when: an element ref would work instead
layers.gotcha: Secure Input silently eats keystrokes while a password field has focus. App Sandbox silently blocks CGEvent.post entirely.

layers.name: vision
layers.summary: Screenshot, ask a model for a coordinate, click it. Most general, worst performing.
layers.token_cost: high; roughly 1500 tokens per screenshot, one per step
use_when: canvas apps: games, Figma, video, remote desktop
last resort after the Electron fix failed
avoid_when: the accessibility tree has the element
layers.gotcha: Retina is 2x. Screenshot pixels are not screen points. Halve returned coordinates or downscale before sending.

layers.name: browser
layers.summary: Drive the browser through its own protocol, not through pixels.
avoid_when: canvas-rendered web apps, which are a layer 5 case
layers.gotcha: A fresh Playwright browser is logged into nothing. Attach to the user's running Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 to keep their sessions.

layers.name: sandbox
layers.summary: Give the agent a machine that is not the user's.
layers.reach: universal, but with none of the user's context
layers.token_cost: same as whatever layer runs inside it
use_when: long-running work that would hold the cursor
avoid_when: the task needs the user's logged-in state, which is most personal tasks
